libcontainer: Allow users to specify mount() flags for rootfs Since MS_BIND ignores all flags (except MS_REC) in favor of the original filesystem's flags, we need a second mount() call to set/remove any flags. This change adds methods to set/get such flags. BUG=b:31630024 TEST=ARC still boots TEST=FEATURES="test" emerge-${BOARD} chromeos-base/libcontainer Change-Id: Iea67463e6fcaba3383de84f39657663e9c25f622 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/388774 Commit-Ready: Luis Hector Chavez <lhchavez@google.com> Tested-by: Luis Hector Chavez <lhchavez@google.com> Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org>

login: Explicitly remount the container's rootfs with no flags This change explicitly remounts the containers' rootfs with no flags, since it is mounted in Chrome OS with nosuid, noexec, nodev. BUG=b:31630024 TEST=Android still boots. TEST=FEATURES="test" emerge-${BOARD} chromeos-base/chromeos-login Change-Id: I7ac775fde9fbc8aa6c0caf5a31675762ba3de48a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/388775 Commit-Ready: Luis Hector Chavez <lhchavez@google.com> Tested-by: Luis Hector Chavez <lhchavez@google.com> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org>

Adding av_webcam suite to run on av-flex DUT pool. Over the last few weeks we've created a space in Cassandra to host some DUTs that the AV team can have better control over, regarding things like lighting and installation of custom test hardware. This change is intended to start making use of that pool for WebCam tests. Also, removing camera_perbuild because it is only being used by one test and is too generic for our use. BUG=None TEST=None Change-Id: I58b8042e11654fcf2b6b15c356327dac5f64bef4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/387263 Commit-Ready: Rohit Makasana <rohitbm@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rohit Makasana <rohitbm@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rohit Makasana <rohitbm@chromium.org>
